map.先看有没有走索引：用 explain() 看执行计划，COLLSCAN 表示全表: First check whether it uses an index: run explain() to inspect the plan, where COLLSCAN means a full collection scan. Common causes include query fields without an index, regex or $where that cannot use an index, and sort fields that do not match the index. Also note that $lookup is effectively a join and gets expensive at scale — consider denormalizing or processing in batches.
